name: THE PEST
source:
When the power goes out, you're left even more alone than you usually would be. It turns out, you're not quite as alone as you should be, either.

[From [url=https://galactinqq.itch.io/the-pest]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当停电时，你会比平时更加​​孤独。事实证明，你也并不像应有的那么孤独。

[来自[url=https://galactinqq.itch.io/the-pest]Itch.io[/url]]
